L01.label: afflicted
L01.quote: the person was a common man, hardly getting 100 chips a month
L01.note: Conclusion is in the Remarks of No. 73, about 120 lines after the cited line; also 'he has neither knowledge nor wealth, he is penurious' at ~14857.

L02.label: favourable
L02.quote: Consequently the fourth house is quite strong rendering the native enjoy the fortune of possessing his mother till his age of 52.
L02.note: The window held the children chapter; Chart 75's mother passage is at lines 4680-4695 (date 17-7-1895 matches).

L03.label: favourable
L03.quote: The native has a generally happy married life but Rahu in the 7th, Mars aspecting Saturn adversely and associating with Kalatrakaraka Venus can give domestic bickerings.
L03.note: Mostly happy, with only a caveat about bickerings; it could be read as mixed.

L04.label: favourable
L04.quote: Actually so far 13 children have been bom out of which, due to affliction of the 5th lord and PutraKaraka by Mars and Saturn respectively, the native has lost 3 issues.
L04.note: Many children with 3 lost; Raman says the combinations indicate 'birth as well as loss of children', so mixed is defensible.

L05.label: afflicted
L05.quote: The potentiality of the 10th house which would have made him a great monarch has been completely shattered

L06.label: favourable
L06.quote: The native has a happy married life. The aspect of 7th lord Jupiter on the 7th and of Karaka Venus also on it have given the native a devoted wife.
L06.note: The window covered Chart 211's 11th house (elder siblings). The same birth data (21-5-1940, 7-50 a.m.) is Chart No. 12 in the 7th-house chapter, and the spouse conclusion is there.

L07.label: afflicted
L07.quote: Hence the native has had no issues horn to him, even though married to 4 wives.

L08.label: mixed
L08.quote: The degree of wealth shown is not very considerable and is frequently acquired by dint of hard labour. In the Navamsha, Rahu is in the 2nd while 2nd lord is in the 12th. This indicates loss due to the displeasure of the Government.
L08.note: Moderate wealth earned by hard labour, plus a loss; it leans afflicted.

L09.label: mixed
L09.quote: The Nizam's horoscope is peculiarly disposed, as side by side with powerful Dhana yogas, there are combinations approximating to Rajabhanga Neecha yogas.
L09.note: For self, Raman gives gentle and just traits but also 'a wavering and weak mentality'; 'Lagna lord weak ... are the drawbacks' (11662).

L10.label: favourable
L10.quote: The first house factors are fairly well disposed. The native has an attractive appearance.

L11.label: favourable
L11.quote: the native was considered the foremost authority in the psychology of sex and his Studies in the Psychology of Sex are a classic of their kind.
L11.note: Litigation is noted, but his career ended in world recognition.

L12.label: mixed
L12.quote: These dispositions indicate strides in career and lack of happiness.
L12.note: Good character and looks are described, but the passage ends with 'Lacks happiness'.

L13.label: favourable
L13.quote: during Venus Dasa, Hyder reached the zenith of his political career, all by sheer ability and efford.

L14.label: mixed
L14.quote: The house of children is unfortunately afflicted as Saturn occupies the 5th and as Putrakaraka is in conjunction with Rahu. The general strength of Jupiter has however resulted in at least one issue becoming prominent.
L14.note: An affliction with one mitigation; it could be read as afflicted.

L15.label: afflicted
L15.quote: The native's father died in April 1979 in Rahu Bhukti of Mercury Dasa.
L15.note: The native was born 1958, so the father died when the native was about 20; Raman notes the 9th lord is blemished.

L16.label: afflicted
L16.quote: an intelligent hardworking lady, an M.A., B.T., who remained unmarried and died in her 27th year. T.B. was suspected in 1947

L17.label: mixed
L17.quote: the glorified position of lord of Lagna in the 9th with the 9th lord and affliction of this combination by Saturn and Rahu, resulting in obstruction of the free flow of fortunate influences
L17.note: Also: 'Arishta yogas for suffering evenly balanced with Rajayogas' (~7273).

L18.label: afflicted
L18.quote: Though it is 30 years since he married, the native has had no issues born to him.

L19.label: afflicted
L19.quote: Mark the fact that the 7th lord Mars is subject to the combined aspects of Rahu, Ketu and Saturn while Kalatrakaraka Venus is equally strongly afflicted denoting Bahukalatra Yoga.
L19.note: This is a conclusion of many wives (harem), framed as affliction; Raman says nothing directly about marital happiness.

L20.label: favourable
L20.quote: Hence his life of simple austerity, his insatiable zeal in the praise of Sri Rama and his indifference to worldly affluence
L20.note: Dharma is shown as a saintly, devotional life; the 9th is named explicitly at 6048-6049.

L21.label: afflicted
L21.quote: The fourth house is moderately strong, but the lord and the Karaka are considerably afflicted. Hence the native lost his mother very early.

L22.label: favourable
L22.quote: Marutha Yoga has considerably contributed to his social, financial and professional eminence.
L22.note: 'chart 38' is NH No. 38, Henry Ford; also 'a great engineer and industrialist' (8502).

L23.label: favourable
L23.quote: The house, the lord and the Karaka being fairly well disposed, endowed the native with considerable intellectual equipment.

L24.label: afflicted
L24.quote: In Chart No. 56, the third house is aspected by Saturn and the third lord is debilitated in the 6th. The native is partially deaf.

L25.label: afflicted
L25.quote: These positions are enough to deprive the native of his father.
L25.note: The father died in 1884, when the native was about 21.

L26.label: none
L26.note: Chart 38 is used only as a timing example: the Venus sub-period in Saturn Dasa was 'important ... from a financial viewpoint' and he became Speaker (2608-2610). Raman gives no judgment of wealth.

L27.label: favourable
L27.quote: Das had an unerring instinct for the weak points in an adversary's position and a tenacious resolution in the execution of his own plans which raised him far above the level of the ablest of his associates.
L27.note: There were setbacks (briefless lawyer, gave up practice, jailed), but he became Congress President and a great leader.

L28.label: favourable
L28.quote: The 7th lord Moon is well placed and Kalatrakaraka is neechabhanga, so that married life would be fairly happy.
L28.note: The native is female; the husband had misfortunes in one sub-period.

L29.label: afflicted
L29.quote: Mark the affliction of the Kalatra Bhave. ... These combinations lend credence to the romour that the native married five wives.

L30.label: afflicted
L30.quote: "if ever there was a marital tragedy, long-drawn out and with its roots extending deep into the past, here was one

L31.label: favourable
L31.quote: The blending of martian and venusian influences gave him a sound body and a sound mind.
L31.note: Also 'In Rasi the Lagna is very strong' (9392).

L32.label: afflicted
L32.quote: In Sun Dasha Moon Bhukti, the native had ... a serious attack of smallpox.
L32.note: The text is split by the Chart 114 header; Raman says Jupiter's aspect gives slight relief.

L33.label: favourable
L33.quote: The association of the 11th lord Venus with Mercury has given the native considerable earnings through the business of money lending.

L34.label: favourable
L34.quote: All these factors account for the queen's prolific motherhood. It will be seen that she gave birth to nine children.

L35.label: favourable
L35.quote: The native can command lakhs of rupees. Venus (he is exalted in Navamsha) in the 10th from Dhana Lagna gave immense wealth in the course of his Dasha.
